description: K₅NaFe₂(CO₂)₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic P4_132 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.12 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.75 Å) and three longer (3.06 Å) K-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal pyramidal geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.46 Å. Fe is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.03 Å) and three longer (2.05 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.29 Å) C-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Fe, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one K, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two K and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, one Na, and one C atom.
